FN-L5HELYY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 273
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/15/2025
House Bill 273 as introduced could increase the obligations of the various public institutions of
higher education by an undetermined amount dependent on any costs to implement and
administer a "Hunger-Free Campus" program on their respective campuses, as provided by this
bill, which would be offset, in part or in whole, by grant funding from the Alabama Commission
of Higher Education (ACHE), subject to appropriation by the Legislature.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of ACHE to adopt rules to
administer and implement the program, which will be offset, in whole or in part, by ACHE's
retention of a percentage of the appropriation for program expenses.
